description: Closes a signature request that is ACTIVE, PARTIALLY_SIGNED or REJECTED, ending the signing process before every signatory has signed. Irreversible: confirm with your user first. Asynchronous: the request moves to CLOSING and the platform finishes the close afterwards, so poll signature_request_get until the status is no longer CLOSING. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId, signature_request_create → requestId. Returns no body.
name: signature_request_close
